topic: Google & IITs Ignite Decentralized AI Research

📰 Google & IITs Ignite Decentralized AI Research

Google's grant to IIT Kharagpur and the IIT Patna Research Park are spearheading a major shift to decentralize AI research. This initiative aims to cultivate diverse regional talent and foster open innovation beyond traditional tech hubs, redefining global AI development.
